appraisal_events.evidence: Maintenant laissez-moi appeler mon ordonnance pour qu'il s'occupe de notre dîner ... Plusieurs fois entrèrent l'un ou l'autre des camarades de Saint-Loup. Il les jetait à la porte. — Allons, fous le camp.
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup brusquely turns away his own comrades to keep the evening for the narrator and personally sees to their dinner, a display of warmth that moves the narrator to hide tears.

status_effects.explanation: His readiness to dismiss his own comrades and arrange for dinner shows a depth of care for the narrator that casts him favorably.
